project.name: Hot Wheels News Bot
project.description: A Python news pipeline that collects Hot Wheels articles, filters and deduplicates them, queues accepted items, transcreates them into Russian, and publishes them on a fixed schedule.

milestone.title: Reduce false broad-pair duplicate flags
milestone.goal: Require a shared broad series to be present in both article titles before issuing E014, while preserving true duplicates, distinctive-pair blocking, fail-open behavior, and truthful operator diagnostics.
